caption: The drawing is a detailed, colored illustration of a decorative door knocker. The main color used is a golden yellow with shading in darker tones to depict depth and metallic texture. The composition includes three views of the knocker: a front view, a left side profile, and a separate part shown below, likely the striker plate. The front view shows the main body consisting of a rectangular block on top, adorned with two symmetrical sphinx-like creatures lying on either side of a central round ornament. Below this, a U-shaped handle with fluted detailing and decorative ends attaches to the block. The side profile shows the thickness and curvature of the handle and block. The separate piece below the handle is round and fluted, consistent with the main knocker’s styling. A small scale in inches is drawn near the bottom left, labeled "JANET RIZA" beneath it. The objects are carefully rendered inside a simple rectangular border, and the background is a plain tan color.
title: Door Knocker
